senses.sense_definition: Any of the subatomic constituents, such as quarks and gluons, that make up a compound particle like a hadron.

examples.text: Physicists use high-energy collisions to study the behavior of a <w>parton</w> inside a proton.
The distribution of each <w>parton</w> helps explain the complex internal structure of hadrons.

senses.sense_definition: A surname of English origin derived from any of several place names.

examples.text: Dolly <w>Parton</w> is celebrated around the world for her country music and philanthropy.
We met Professor <w>Parton</w> after the lecture to discuss her latest research paper.

senses.sense_definition: A coastal village and civil parish in Cumberland, Cumbria, England.

examples.text: The railway line runs right past the village of <w>Parton</w> along the Cumbrian coast.
They took a scenic walk through <w>Parton</w> to enjoy views of the Irish Sea.

senses.sense_definition: A hamlet in Thursby parish, Cumberland, Cumbria, England.

examples.text: The quiet hamlet of <w>Parton</w> is situated just south of the main road near Thursby.
Few motorists notice the turnoff for <w>Parton</w> when driving through rural Cumbria.

senses.sense_definition: A hamlet in Eardisley parish, Herefordshire, England, also known as Great Parton.

examples.text: Historic records show farming settlements around <w>Parton</w> dating back several centuries.
The rural community of <w>Parton</w> remains a peaceful corner of the Herefordshire countryside.

senses.sense_definition: A hamlet in Kirkcudbrightshire, Dumfries and Galloway council area, Scotland.

examples.text: The churchyard in <w>Parton</w> contains the burial place of the physicist James Clerk Maxwell.
Visitors often stop at <w>Parton</w> while exploring the Galloway countryside.
